Liiga game shootout

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_game_shootout.Rd

One game's shootout attempts: shooter, goalkeeper and result (none for a game without one).

Usage

liiga_game_shootout(season, game_id)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Game ids repeat across seasons, so a game is (season, game_id).

game_id

Game id (game_id in liiga_schedule or liiga_games), e.g. 1; unique only within a season.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (11 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
game_idintegerGame id, unique only within a season: key a game as (season, game_id).
shooting_player_idintegerShooter's player id.
blocking_player_idintegerGoalkeeper's player id.
shot_numberintegerAttempt number in the shootout.
shooting_team_idintegerTeam id of the shooter's team (the number of the <num>:<slug> key).
shooting_team_slugcharacterSlug of the shooter's team (e.g. hpk).
blocking_team_idintegerGoalkeeper's team id.
blocking_team_slugcharacterGoalkeeper's team slug.
goal_scoredlogicalThe attempt scored.
winning_goallogicalGame-winning goal.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id}

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()
